turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, how can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello, my name is Chloe. I am having trouble accessing my online account because I lost my phone with two-factor authentication on it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can reset that for you. May I have your full name?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, my name is Chloe Zhang.

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Chloe Zhang.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could I have your email address to send you the reset code?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm afraid I don't have that information.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you know your PIN number?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay, I can send the reset email to the address on file for that account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, I will reset it now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Contact us again if you need additional assistance. Is there anything else I can help you with at the moment?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That should be everything for today. I appreciate your help!
